integrity: The proof is symbolic. Exact subgroup-lattice calculations for the two extraspecial groups of order 27 and a finite vector-space cover check are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to odd-prime extraspecial groups.
No corresponding classification is asserted for extraspecial 2-groups or more general special p-groups.
The literature comparison cannot exclude a poorly indexed specialization of the general subgroup-intersection literature.
title: Domination in subgroup intersection graphs of odd extraspecial groups
